I express my gratitude to the Chief Minister and to all the NDA leaders for giving me the opportunity to pass through among all of you, to have your darshan, and to have the opportunity to bow before you. I do not think this enormous gathering can even be fully captured by the cameras. Such a vast gathering of people. This is living proof of the awakening towards development. Friends, The great festival of faith, Chhath, has just concluded. Our mothers and sisters observed the difficult waterless fast and prayed for the welfare of their families, society, and the world. And now, with the blessings of Chhathi Maiya, we are here celebrating the festival of development. And therefore, today, the NDA government is completing one year of this term in office. For this occasion, the great land of democracy, Vaishali, has been chosen. On this occasion, I bow to the soil of Vaishali and Bihar. I extend my greetings to all NDA constituent parties, to lakhs of workers, and to all the people of Bihar. Friends, About three decades ago, Bihar chose a new path of hope and confidence. Bihar, which had suffered neglect and decline for decades, received a new assurance of good governance under the leadership of respected Nitish ji. In this sequence, development projects worth thousands of crores of rupees have been inaugurated and launched here today as well. And I have complete faith that wherever my friend Ram Vilas ji’s soul may be, he must be showering flowers upon us right now because we are fulfilling his dreams as well. bihar_raw_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates AI Centre At IIT Patna, Initiates Rs 400 Crore Research Park Project
bihar_raw_news.content: PM Modi Inaugurates AI Centre At IIT Patna, Initiates Rs 400 Crore Research Park Project By Sahil Behl Last Updated: Nov 22, 2026, 14:36 IST Prime Minister Narendra Modi virtually inaugurated the AI Centre of Excellence at IIT Patna and laid the foundation stones for a Rs. 400 crore research park and a 120-bed startup hostel on November 21. PM Modi Inaugurates AI Centre At IIT Patna, Initiates Rs 400 Crore Research Park Project Register for Result Updates Prime Minister Narendra Modi on November 21 virtually inaugurated the Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence (AI) at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Patna. He also laid the foundation stones for the IIT Patna Research Park and a 120-bed hostel for startup incubatees. The projects aim to strengthen research, innovation and entrepreneurship in Bihar. The Prime Minister’s Office (PMO), in its official announcement, revealed IIT Patna Research Park and hostel among the development projects for which foundation stones were laid during the PM's Bihar visit. Rs 400 Crore Research Park at IIT Patna The proposed research park will be developed with an investment of Rs. 400 crore. Of this amount, Rs. 305 crore will be contributed by the Bihar government, while the remaining Rs. 95 crore will come from the Higher Education Financing Agency (HEFA). The facility will support startups, micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), and researchers. It will provide facilities for designing, developing and testing prototypes. The research park will also have facilities for research and development, fabrication, manufacturing, testing and product certification. These facilities are expected to help researchers and startups turn their ideas into products. 120-Bed Hostel for Startup Teams The Prime Minister also laid the foundation stone for a 120-bed hostel for startup incubatees at IIT Patna. The hostel will accommodate entrepreneurs associated with the institute’s startup incubation programmes. They will have access to laboratories and guidance from faculty members while working on their projects. AI Centre of Excellence at IIT Patna The Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence has been established with a planned investment of ₹60 crore. It will operate as a Section 8 company, a non-profit organisation under the Companies Act. The Bihar government’s Information Technology Department, the Union Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, and industry partner Tiger Analytics will support the centre financially. IIT Patna will serve as its lead academic partner. Welcoming Prime Minister Modi on his visit to... Daily Excelsior 04:01 AM Nov 22, 2026 IST PATNA, Nov 21 : Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary on Saturday said that the state is moving towards new heights of development with the guidance and support of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Welcoming Prime Minister Modi on his visit to Bihar at a programme organised in Vaishali district, the Chief Minister expressed gratitude for the Centre's continued cooperation, guidance and support in the state's development. On the occasion, the Prime Minister dedicated and laid the foundation stones of various development projects worth around Rs 34,000 crore in Bihar. Among the major projects inaugurated was the six-lane Kacchi Dargah-Bidupur ''Nitish Setu'', constructed at a cost of Rs 5,571.69 crore. Advertisement Other key projects inaugurated included the construction and upgradation of national highways, Unit-2 of the 660 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project, electricity distribution works under the Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS), a floating solar project at Phulwaria Dam, a sewerage project in Kahalgaon, and works related to the strengthening of canals and embankments. The projects for which foundation stones were laid included the four-laning of the NH-139W stretch between Sahebganj, Areraj and Bettiah, the power evacuation system for the Pirpainti Super Thermal Power Project, sewerage and water supply schemes in various cities, and the construction of a research park and hostel at IIT Patna. In addition, 100 PM-e-buses were flagged off, while more than 26,900 beneficiaries were facilitated with housewarming ceremonies under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban). Choudhary said the projects would give fresh impetus to road connectivity, energy, education, urban infrastructure and public welfare in Bihar. Describing the occasion as historic for the state, the Chief Minister said development projects worth approximately Rs 34,000 crore had been inaugurated and their foundation stones laid by the Prime Minister. These initiatives, he said, would open up new opportunities in infrastructure, energy, education, healthcare, urban development and employment. Referring to the inauguration of the Nitish Setu, Choudhary said the bridge marked an important milestone in Bihar's development journey. Stretching approximately 19.36 km, the bridge connects Kacchi Dargah in Patna with Bidupur in Vaishali. The bridge would facilitate smoother movement between the two banks of the Ganga, reduce traffic pressure on the Mahatma Gandhi Setu and JP Setu, and particularly benefit residents of the Raghopur Diara region, he said. The Chief Minister said Prime Minister Modi's vision was that of a ''Developed India'', while former Chief Minister Nitish Kumar's vision was a ''Prosperous Bihar''. bihar_raw_news.title: PM Modi launches several development projects worth ₹34 470 crore in Vaishali - Newsonair
bihar_raw_news.content: News On AIR | November 21, 2026 9:15 PM PM Modi launches several development projects worth ₹34 470 crore in Vaishali; Reiterates commitment to build Bihar that is stronger, more prosperous & full of opportunities Strengthening Bihar’s development and connectivity, Prime Minister Narendra Modi today inaugurated the Nitish Setu in Vaishali. On the occasion, he also inaugurated and laid the foundation stones of development projects worth over 34,000 crore rupees. Addressing the gathering, the Prime Minister highlighted Bihar’s development journey, good governance and various welfare initiatives. The Prime Minister Narendra Modi was accorded a traditional welcome with a stole adorned with Bajjika artwork, flowers made of makhana, a garland of Aparajita flowers and bananas. Following the welcome, the Prime Minister dedicated the six-lane Nitish Setu, built across the River Ganga, to the people of Bihar. Stretching approximately 20 kilometres, the bridge connects Kachchi Dargah in Patna district with Bidupur in Vaishali district. With the inauguration of this bridge, traffic pressure on the Mahatma Gandhi Setu and JP Setu is expected to ease, while connectivity between North and South Bihar will become smoother. The Prime Minister said that the bridge has been named in honour of former Chief Minister Nitish Kumar. He described it as a symbol of his service and dedication to Bihar. Describing Nitish Setu as more than just a means of transportation, the Prime Minister said that the project would make people’s daily lives easier. He added that it would help local products reach larger markets and improve access to education and healthcare services. In his address, the Prime Minister invoked the blessings of Chhathi Maiya and said that Bihar was celebrating a festival of development. He recalled that three decades ago, the people of Bihar had chosen the path of hope and faith, and that under the leadership of Nitish Kumar, the state had gained renewed confidence in good governance. During the programme, the Prime Minister presented a total of 227 development projects to the state. These include the second 660-megawatt unit of the Buxar Thermal Power Project, along with several initiatives related to road construction, power distribution and transmission, irrigation, education, healthcare and urban development. The Prime Minister also flagged off 100 electric buses under the PM-e-Bus initiative and participated in the Griha Pravesh ceremony for more than 26 900 beneficiaries of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban. These projects are expected to strengthen connectivity, expand energy and urban infrastructure, improve public services and give fresh momentum to Bihar’s economic development.

bihar_raw_news.content: Home > Big Story > PM Modi says Bihar has bridged its past; Dedicates Rs 34,000-cr projects, including Nitish Setu over Ganga Big Story PM Modi says Bihar has bridged its past; Dedicates Rs 34,000-cr projects, including Nitish Setu over Ganga BY MPost 22 Nov 2026 12:40 AM IST X MPost 22 Nov 2026 12:40 AM IST Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday took a swipe at previous governments in Bihar, saying the state was once associated with crime and scams but the NDA government has shifted the focus to development and action against criminals. Addressing a gathering, he highlighted Bihar’s progress under the double-engine government. PM Modi cited improvements in infrastructure investment and public welfare. Modi addressed a rally in Jafarpatti of Vaishali district, about 50 km from the state capital, where he dedicated to the nation projects worth more than Rs 34,000 crore, including a bridge over the Ganga. The 9.76-km-long Nitish Setu, a six-lane bridge over the Ganga, connecting Bidupur block in Vaishali district to Kachchi Dargah on the outskirts of Patna has been named ‘Nitish Setu’ after former state chief minister Nitish Kumar. He said Nitish Kumar gave up the post of chief minister in April to make way for a BJP-helmed government and the bridge was named, “as a mark of respect for his contributions to the state”. The bridge has been built at a cost of around Rs 4,280 crore. After its inauguration, Modi, accompanied by Governor Syed Ata Hasnain, Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary, Union Minister Chirag Paswan, and Deputy CM Vijay Kumar Choudhary, walked on the bridge for a few minutes. The PM also waved to the crowd with a ‘gamcha’. “The state has come a long way since the NDA took over. Earlier, only scams and crimes were talked about. Now Bihar makes news for investment proposals and action taken against those who indulge in any type of wrongdoing,” he said. Modi, who was speaking in an area falling under the Hajipur Lok Sabha constituency, represented by Union minister Chirag Paswan, also recalled the contributions of the latter’s late father Ram Vilas Paswan, who had represented the parliamentary seat several times. The PM also trained his guns at the Congress, accusing it of having “misled people with slogans of garibi hatao”, drawing a contrast with the NDA government at the Centre over the last 12 years during which “50 crore people have moved out of the clutches of poverty”. Major road projects that were inaugurated include the six-laning of the NH-19, the Chorma-Bairgania section of NH-227F and the Umagaon-Saharsa section of NH-327, among others, the officials said. The PM inaugurated the second unit (660 MW) of the 1,320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project, along with electricity distribution and transmission infrastructure projects under the Energy Department. Other projects that were inaugurated during the day include restoration and strengthening of canals and embankments, a floating solar project at Phulwaria Dam in Nawada and sewerage infrastructure at Kahalgaon. national_raw_news.title: HM Amit Shah stresses stronger security coordination in Arunachal Pradesh
national_raw_news.content: Union Home Minister Amit Shah has stressed the need for better coordination between Central and State security agencies to maintain peace and security in Arunachal Pradesh. He called for strengthening the local intelligence network and ensuring continuous monitoring of sensitive areas. Considering the strategic importance of Arunachal Pradesh’s nearly 1,126-kilometre-long international border with China, Mr. Shah also reviewed border security arrangements and the development of strategic infrastructure along the frontier. Mr. Shah chaired a high-level review meeting at Lok Bhavan in Itanagar yesterday to discuss key issues relating to law and order, internal security, border management and development in the Northeastern state. The Home Minister also emphasised expanding road connectivity, border outposts, helipads and telecommunication facilities in border areas. He stressed the effective implementation of the Vibrant Villages Programme to enhance livelihood opportunities for local residents. Mr. Shah said that under Mission Krishi Veer and Mission Arun Himveer, a distinct approach should be adopted, under which the requirements of security forces are assessed first and local villages are subsequently equipped to fulfil those needs. Chief Minister Pema Khandu thanked the Union Home Minister for his guidance and assured him that the state government would make every effort to implement the directives and accelerate the state’s development.

national_raw_news.title: Nepal PM Balendra Shah to arrive in New Delhi today on a two-day visit to India
national_raw_news.content: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah will be on a two-day visit to India from today. This will be his first visit to India after assuming office in March this year. On his arrival in New Delhi today, he will hold meeting with External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar. Tomorrow, the Nepal Prime Minister will call on President Droupadi Murmu and also meet Prime Minister Narendra Modi. During the bilateral talks, both Prime Ministers will review the full range of India-Nepal relations and exchange views on regional and international issues of mutual interest. Memorandum of Understanding (MoUs) in various areas will also be exchanged between the two countries. Akashvani Correspondent reports that the Ministry of External Affairs has said that the visit continues the tradition of regular high-level exchanges between the two countries and reflects the importance India attaches to its relations with Nepal under its ‘Neighbourhood First’ policy. It added that the visit will provide an opportunity to further strengthen the bilateral partnership and advance mutually beneficial cooperation. The Ministry further said that India and Nepal share close and friendly relations, rooted in historical, cultural and civilisational links and strong people-to-people ties. Bilateral cooperation has witnessed progress across diverse sectors including trade and commerce, energy and water resources, and digital connectivity. The two countries also witnessed growing engagement in newer areas such as start-ups, technology and innovation, and sports.

national_raw_news.title: PM Modi calls for greater respect for skills, says India moving towards becoming global skill capital
national_raw_news.content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday participated in the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, and called for greater recognition of skilled workers, saying India’s progress in the 21st century depends on respecting skills and craftsmanship. Addressing the gathering, PM Modi said the government had undertaken several initiatives guided by the principle of ‘Shrameva Jayate’ to strengthen skill development and create employment opportunities for young people. He said ITI graduates were now ready to contribute directly to nation-building, adding that skilled workers play a crucial role in strengthening India’s manufacturing capacity and making people’s lives easier. Highlighting India’s traditional craftsmanship, the Prime Minister cited Chikankari, Banarasi silk, Kashmir Pashmina, Kalamkari and other indigenous crafts, saying skills had long been central to the country’s identity and economy. He attributed the decline in the recognition of skilled professions to the colonial education system, which, he said, promoted clerical jobs at the expense of traditional crafts. PM Modi said nearly 5,000 new Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) had been established over the past decade, while enrolment had increased by more than five lakh. The number of girls pursuing ITI education has also risen more than two-and-a-half times, he added. Emphasising the need to align vocational training with emerging technologies, he said more than 30 new-age trades, including artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, drone technology, electric vehicles, industrial robotics, green hydrogen and semiconductor technology, had been introduced in ITIs. The Prime Minister also highlighted an investment of Rs 60,000 crore under the PM-SETU scheme to modernise ITI infrastructure, upgrade machinery, train instructors and strengthen industry linkages. Addressing concerns over artificial intelligence replacing jobs, PM Modi said skilled workers would continue to have employment opportunities, citing their contribution during the COVID-19 pandemic. He said emerging sectors such as renewable energy, sports manufacturing and infrastructure were generating growing demand for skilled manpower. Announcing a major opportunity for Indian youth, the Prime Minister said India would host the WorldSkills Asia competition in Greater Noida in 2027, bringing together participants from several countries. He also highlighted Uttar Pradesh’s development under Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, citing expressways, international airports, educational institutions, mobile manufacturing facilities and the upcoming semiconductor factory as drivers of employment and investment. Urging young people to pursue skill development and aim high, PM Modi said India was moving towards becoming the skill capital of the world. He encouraged ITI graduates to make full use of emerging opportunities and contribute to the vision of a developed India. PIB

national_raw_news.content: BHASHINI’s voice prescription tool moves from pilot to wider rollout in public healthcare | Business About Career Advertisement Media Partnership Contact Us HOME NEWS RESEARCH LIVE DISCOURSE PERSPECTIVES AND INSIGHTS SUBMIT PRESS RELEASE NEWS DESK RESEARCH LIVE DISCOURSE PERSPECTIVES AND INSIGHTS INTERVIEW Home News Education Article BHASHINI’s voice prescription tool moves from pilot to wider rollout in public healthcare AIIMS has integrated BHASHINI’s speech-to-text technology into the National Informatics Centre’s eHospital prescription module. The tool lets doctors dictate prescriptions directly into the hospital’s electronic system during outpatient consultations. ANI | Updated: 21-11-2026 18:53 IST | Created: 21-11-2026 18:53 IST The BHASHINI stall at the Global Digital Health Summit in New Delhi (Photo/PIB). Image Credit: ANI SHARE Key Takeaways AI Summary Analyzing article... Government-backed language AI platform BHASHINI’s voice prescription tool is moving from a two-department pilot to an institute-wide rollout at AIIMS New Delhi, a Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology release said on Saturday. AIIMS has integrated BHASHINI’s speech-to-text technology into the National Informatics Centre’s eHospital prescription module. The tool lets doctors dictate prescriptions directly into the hospital’s electronic system during outpatient consultations. “The platform has proved useful in supporting clinical workflows, with positive feedback from doctors during the pilot in Neurology and Neurosurgery. Building on this experience, the application is now being rolled out across the institute,” said Prof Vivek Tandon, professor in charge of the computer facility at AIIMS New Delhi. The rollout was highlighted at the Global Digital Health Summit in New Delhi, where BHASHINI also showcased how JIPMER and the Indian Army are using voice AI in their existing hospital systems. The Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) has integrated BHASHINI into its e-Sushrut hospital management system. Doctors can dictate case histories, inpatient notes and discharge instructions in English or supported Indian languages. Dr Anand A of JIPMER said the institute aims to “make clinical workflows more efficient and reduce documentation burdens on healthcare professionals.” The Army’s Directorate General of Medical Services demonstrated how its Dhanwantri system converts doctors’ spoken clinical notes into typed text. Maj Gen Sandeep Bhalla said the Army sought multilingual support because its patients, including serving personnel, veterans and their families, speak different languages. Private hospitals have also been exploring voice-based prescribing. Global Health Ltd, which operates Medanta hospitals, said in its FY2024–25 annual report that it was implementing an AI-based electronic medical records platform with a feature that transcribes and categorises spoken prescriptions. The Union Health Ministry also showcased a voice-to-text prescription tool integrated into a hospital management system at the India AI Impact Expo in February 2026. Taking to the social media platform X, President Murmu extended her condolences to the families of the victims. "The news of the deaths in a road accident in Kutch , Gujarat, is deeply saddening. I express my heartfelt condolences to all the bereaved family members of the deceased," the President said in her post. According to police officials, at least seven people, including three children and two women, were killed after the car they were travelling in collided with a truck on the Bhuj-Khavda highway near Vekariya Rann in Kutch district. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has announced an ex-gratia of Rs 2 lakh from the Prime Minister's National Relief Fund (PMNRF) for the next of kin of each of those who lost their lives, while those injured in the accident will receive Rs 50,000 each. “Saddened by the loss of lives due to a mishap in Kutch , Gujarat. The injured would be given Rs. 50,000.” According to Kutch Superintendent of Police Vikas Sunda, the accident occurred between 9.30 pm and 10 pm on November 21 when a car travelling from Khavda towards Bhuj collided with a truck coming from the opposite direction. A car travelling from Khavda toward Bhuj collided with a truck moving from Bhuj toward Khavda,” he said. Preliminary observations suggest that the collision occurred while the car was attempting to overtake the truck, Sunda said. Speaking about the incident, the SP said the occupants of the car sustained injuries following the collision. A police team reached the spot and immediately initiated rescue operations, while an ambulance was also called. However, all seven occupants of the car, comprising two men, two women and three children, died in the accident. “Preliminary observations suggest that the collision occurred while the car was attempting an overtake. An ambulance was summoned; however, unfortunately, all seven individuals in the car—comprising two men, two women, and three children—lost their lives,” he said. national_raw_news.title: India's Barrier-Free Toll Network Expands As NHAI Activates Third MLFF Plaza In Tamil Nadu
national_raw_news.content: India's Barrier-Free Toll Network Expands As NHAI Activates Third MLFF Plaza In Tamil Nadu Infrastructure India's Barrier-Free Toll Network Expands As NHAI Activates Third MLFF Plaza In Tamil Nadu Swarajya Staff Nov 22, 2026 | Updated 12:02 PM GMT+5:30 Save & read from anywhere! Bookmark stories for easy access on any device or the Swarajya app . Sign In Prefer Prefer Pic Via PIB The National Highways Authority of India has implemented its Multi-Lane Free Flow tolling system at the Chennasamudram Toll Plaza in Tamil Nadu's Ranipet district, enabling motorists to pass through without stopping at conventional toll booths. The barrier-free system, which uses FASTag and Automatic Number Plate Recognition cameras, marks Tamil Nadu's third MLFF deployment following earlier installations at Paranur and Nemili toll plazas. Located at kilometre 104.900 on National Highway 48 near Walajapet, the Chennasamudram plaza serves the busy Chennai-Bengaluru corridor. The 46.5-kilometre tollable stretch handles significant daily traffic volumes as vehicles travel between Tamil Nadu's capital and India's technology hub. The plaza features 12 toll lanes equipped with overhead cameras and RFID readers that automatically detect and deduct toll charges. The MLFF technology allows vehicles to travel at speeds up to 150 kilometres per hour while toll collection occurs seamlessly. RFID readers identify FASTag-equipped vehicles, whilst ANPR cameras capture registration plates for vehicles without valid tags. The system verifies data in real time and processes payments through linked accounts, eliminating the need for vehicles to slow down or queue at physical barriers. India's first MLFF system launched at Chorayasi Toll Plaza in Gujarat in May 2026, with the technology subsequently expanding to locations across Rajasthan, Haryana and Delhi. Tamil Nadu joined the rollout when Paranur toll plaza became operational on 1 October 2026, followed by Nemili on 13 November. NHAI is deploying the system at 16 toll plazas nationwide as part of its phased implementation strategy. The barrier-free model is expected to reduce fuel consumption and vehicular emissions by eliminating idling at toll plazas. The technology also lowers operational costs associated with maintaining physical toll infrastructure whilst strengthening transparency in toll operations. Highway users must maintain valid FASTag accounts with sufficient balance to avoid electronic notices or payment-related action under the new system.
